# MaNoir Documentation

> Expanded documentation index for MaNoir, a self-hosted home platform.

Base URL: https://manoir-app.github.io

## Overview

- [Documentation Home](https://manoir-app.github.io/): Documentation landing page for MaNoir.
- [Self-Hosted Installation](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation): Overview of deployment targets, Gaia bootstrap, and minimum vital services.
- [User Guide](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide): Entry point for all end-user and operator-facing usage domains.
- [Developer Guide](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/developer): Entry point for extending MaNoir with plugins.

## Installation

- [Overview](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation): Install and operate MaNoir on infrastructure you control.
- [Requirements](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation/requirements): Hardware, OS, runtime, and other prerequisites.
- [Configuration](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation/configuration): Runtime settings, secrets, and shared configuration.
- [Docker Deployment](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation/deployment): Step-by-step Docker-based installation path.
- [Kubernetes Deployment](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation/kubernetes): Initial guidance for small-cluster deployments.
- [Upgrade](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation/upgrade): Upgrade and lifecycle guidance for existing installations.

## User Guide: Administration

- [Administration Overview](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/administration): Administration domain overview.
- [Users](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/administration/users): Manage user accounts.
- [Roles](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/administration/roles): Manage roles and permissions.
- [Settings](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/administration/settings): Configure system-level settings.

## User Guide: Home Automation

- [Home Automation Overview](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/home-automation): Home automation domain overview.
- [Devices](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/home-automation/devices): Manage connected devices.
- [Automations](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/home-automation/automations): Create and manage automation rules.
- [Scenes](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/home-automation/scenes): Define and trigger scenes.

## User Guide: Daily Life Management

- [Daily Life Overview](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/daily-life): Daily life management domain overview.
- [Calendar](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/daily-life/calendar): Work with calendars and scheduling.
- [Tasks](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/daily-life/tasks): Track tasks and household workflows.
- [Shopping](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/daily-life/shopping): Manage shopping lists.

## User Guide: Possession Management

- [Possessions Overview](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/possessions): Possession management domain overview.
- [Inventory](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/possessions/inventory): Track and browse belongings.
- [Categories](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/possessions/categories): Organize possessions into categories.
- [Maintenance](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/possessions/maintenance): Plan and review maintenance tasks.

## Developer Guide

- [Developer Overview](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/developer): Overview of MaNoir plugin development.
- [Plugins Overview](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/developer/plugins): Start building MaNoir plugins.
- [Getting Started](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/developer/plugins/getting-started): Initial plugin implementation guidance.
- [API Reference](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/developer/plugins/api-reference): Reference material for plugin APIs.
- [Publishing](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/developer/plugins/publishing): Package and publish plugins.

## Project Links

- [GitHub Organization](https://github.com/manoir-app): Source repositories for MaNoir projects.
